name: append-eof-newline
description: Append a new section at end-of-file AND delete the trailing blank line after '- packaging fixes' in one call. Probes EOF authorization (append requires a read that displayed EOF) and precise handling of the file's terminal region.
prompt: Edit changelog.md using ONLY the read and edit tools. Make two changes in ONE edit call: (1) append a new section at the very end of the file consisting of the lines '## 1.1.0', '', '- append probe', '- newline probe'; (2) the file currently ends with a blank line after '- packaging fixes' - exactly one blank line must remain between '- packaging fixes' and the '## 1.1.0' heading, and the file must end after '- newline probe' with a single trailing newline and no blank line at the end. Do not use any other tool.

expectedFiles.changelog.md:
# Changelog

## 1.0.0

- initial release
- packaging fixes

## 1.1.0

- append probe
- newline probe
